name: io.github.grubbomatic/crawl-readiness
description: Check whether ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and 50+ other AI crawlers can read a website — then generate the llms.txt, robots.txt and JSON-LD that fix it, and read your brand's share-of-voice trend across AI answers.

environmentVariables.name: CRAWL_READINESS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Free API key from https://www.crawlreadiness.com/dashboard. The four audit tools work without it; the three generators and get_monitor_trend need it.

environmentVariables.name: CRAWL_READINESS_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Only useful for testing against a preview deployment; defaults to https://www.crawlreadiness.com.
